Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded the task and misidentified Eugene V. Debs’s party as the Social Democratic Party of America. While Debs helped found a Social Democratic organization, he is most prominently and correctly identified as a leader and five-time presidential candidate of the Socialist Party of America. The error stems from conflating related entities and failing to cross-verify the specific party affiliation before marking the task complete.
